intro.fr: One Must Fall: 2097 se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: One Must Fall: 2097 can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Diversions Entertainment sort One Must Fall: 2097 en 1994.
text.en: Diversions Entertainment releases One Must Fall: 2097 in 1994.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld, qui héberge l'APWorld de One Must Fall: 2097.
text.en: The GitHub repository stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld, home of the One Must Fall: 2097 APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, omf-0.0.3.
text.en: The first version, omf-0.0.3, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version omf-0.0.5, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (3 versions publiées).
text.en: Version omf-0.0.5 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (3 versions released).

text.fr: One Must Fall: 2097 figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: One Must Fall: 2097 is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
